purpose: Define each machine-significant processing purpose as an explicit identity usable in collection, access, derivation, export and retention decisions.

topics.name: Data Processing Purpose Identity
topics.purpose: Define each machine-significant processing purpose as an explicit identity usable in collection, access, derivation, export and retention decisions.

semantics.identity_rule: Each processing purpose has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.owner_rule: Purpose owner/controller/business owner is explicit where applicable.
semantics.retention_rule: Purpose may reference exact retention profile.
semantics.authority_rule: Purpose declaration does not itself authorize processing.
semantics.label_rule: Human purpose text is descriptive and not the sole identity.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.
